## This week

You posted 5 videos this week. That is one more than last week. Your typical video this week got about 3,100 views. Last week it was about 2,200 views. So you are moving up.

Your best video was the one that starts with "Breaking down EXACTLY how i made $100K w UGC." That one pulled 8,202 views. Nice.

Your weakest was the one that starts with "is coming from a girl who made $10,000 in her first 48 hours." That one only got 530 views, even though it covers a similar money topic. Worth asking why that one did not land the same way.

## Is it how you film, or what you say?

Here is the honest answer. Almost every video you make is you talking to camera, 132 out of 166 videos. Because of that, we cannot really tell yet if a different filming style would help you. You just have not tried other styles enough to know.

What we can see clearly is that what you talk about matters more than how you film it. And how you lay out the video, like step by step versus just free talking, matters even more than the topic itself.

You do not have any videos yet where you filmed the exact same script two different ways, so we cannot prove this with a clean side by side yet.

Right now, what you say and how you structure it looks like it matters more than how you film it. But you have not tested filming styles enough to be sure.

## What is working

Your videos about how you got started usually pull about twice your normal views. You have posted 29 of those, so that pattern is real.

Your videos with real money numbers do even better, about three and a half times your normal views. You have only posted 7 of these, so keep an eye on it, but it is promising.

Longer videos, over a minute, are your biggest winners by far, about seven times your normal views. You have posted 11 of these.

## Try this next week

Film another real money numbers breakdown like your best video this week. Open with the number, then show the proof.

Let one video run past a minute instead of cutting it short. Your longer videos are massively outperforming.

Try your how you got started story using voice over footage instead of talking to camera. One video like that already did huge numbers, so test it again to see if it was luck or a real pattern.

best.md:
This video came in just under your normal, landing at about 4,031 views while your typical video gets 4,800. So this one was a little behind, not a disaster.

Your opening line was "girls that want to learn how to get paid to just make get ready with me all day without having any followers." That's a strong says the value up front hook, and this style of hook usually does better than normal for you, pulling in about 23% more views than your usual. So the hook itself wasn't the problem here.

After the hook, the video explains the idea well, but it leans on telling instead of pulling people forward with curiosity. There's no real moment in the middle that makes someone need to see what happens next, so some viewers likely drifted off partway through.

Your call to action was "I'm gonna go live on Thursday," dropped right at the very end. By that point most people have already clicked away, so it couldn't do its job.

Next time, move your ask earlier, maybe right after you explain the opportunity, and give people a clear reason to stick around in the middle of the video, not just at the start.

worst.md:
This video did badly. It only got 305 views, while your normal video gets way more, over 15 times more.

Your opening line was "I told you three months get everything that you wanted? dream job, your dream man." This hook style, a very specific situation, usually does great for you, over 3 times your normal views. But this time it did not land that way, so the idea was good but something in the delivery or topic did not pull people in this time.

After the opening, the video does keep building. It stays on one clear pain point, the gap between where you are and the life you want, and pushes into the solution of acting like your best self now. That structure usually works fine for you.

There was no call to action at all. You could have asked people to follow for more mindset talks like this, or to comment the one thing they want most in three months.

Next time, keep this same hook style since it is one of your strongest, but test it with a different topic or delivery, and add a clear ask early or mid video instead of skipping it.
